referenceSources.title: cite今、振り返るGT500マシンの歴史／トヨタ編 SUPRA──今年、A90型GRスープラがレースに復活
referenceSources.description:
An orange and silver Toyota Supra GT500 car, adorned with Bridgestone, TRD, au by KDDI Racing Team, and field/dream logos, powers through a racetrack corner. Its illuminated headlights and aerodynamic bodywork, including a prominent rear wing, emphasize its high-performance racing setup.

This image ties into the legacy of the JZA80 Supra in Japan’s top-tier GT500 class. From its debut in the 1993 JGTC to its dramatic 2005 title victory at Suzuka Circuit in heavy rain, the Supra has been a championship contender. The blog post recounts its multiple wins, endurance race successes, and the model’s final GT500 season, while looking forward to the modern GR Supra’s return to Super GT competition.
